projects.category: Emotional well-being app for students and educators

projects.delivery: Revamped using Flutter with Riverpod state management, RESTful API integration, and modular architecture for maintainable cross-platform support.
projects.impact: Created a digital safe space where students freely share feelings, making emotional management engaging and accessible.
